summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its senior secured revolving credit facility. The amendment added Apple Bank and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank as lenders with commitments of $35 million and $50 million, respectively, while reducing CIBC Bank USA's commitment. Aggregate borrowing capacity remains unchanged at $200 million. No other material terms were modified. This is a routine financing arrangement update with no special-situation implications.
